videos.caption: Nobody talks about this part of raising meat chickens. 😅🐓 We raise Cornish Cross meat birds on our homestead because our family eats chicken, and I wanted to understand where our food actually comes from. But apparently raising your own food does NOT magically make you unfazed by every part of the process. 😂 This chicken was already processed and I was literally just trying to make dinner when I realized I still had to remove the head. And, as you can see, I handled that with the grace and maturity of a seasoned homesteader. 💀 I think sometimes homesteading content makes people think you eventually become completely disconnected from the reality of raising animals for meat. I haven’t. I can believe in raising our own meat, appreciate the animal, know exactly where our food came from AND still be grossed out while preparing a whole chicken for dinner. So here’s a little behind-the-scenes reality of raising Cornish Cross chickens, processing meat chickens, cooking a whole home-raised chicken and learning how to homestead as we go. We eat meat. We decided we wanted to know where ours came from. And apparently sometimes that means standing in the kitchen going EW EW EW EW EW while making dinner. 😂 #meatchickens #cornishcross #raisingmeatchickens #homestead #homesteading
